**The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was in the `sample_rise` mode-select logic in `rtl/spi_master.v`: the `default` case (SPI mode 3, CPOL=1/CPHA=1) incorrectly set `sample_rise = 1'b0` (sample on falling/leading edge), a leftover duplicate of mode 2's value. Per spec, mode 3 samples `miso` on the rising (trailing) edge, so it needed `sample_rise = 1'b1`. 

- `tb/tb_visible.v` → `TEST PASSED` (0 errors)
- Manually verified mode 3 (which the visible suite doesn't cover) now correctly receives the transmitted byte via loopback.
